value.title: Kaguya Wants to Eat It (Ice) / Our Persona / Kaguya Wants to Confess (Ice)
value.synopsis: After she saw Shirogane's bento lunch box during the lunch break, Kaguya tried to tempt him indirectly for a single bite. He noticed her actions, but due to a certain happening, the distance between the two rapidly closed. However, Kaguya's daring actions cause Shirogane to lose consciousness. While staring at Shirogane asleep in bed, inside Kaguya's head, she is...

value.title: Kaguya Is Fine with It
value.synopsis: Christmas Eve. Friends and lovers. Everyone spends time in their own way. Shirogane and Kaguya, who joined the Fujiwara Family's Christmas party, enjoyed the Fujiwara Family's brand of hospitality. As the fun time passed quickly, they found themselves on the way home. The two, who cannot express their honest feelings, sit side-by-side on a park bench.

value.title: Fujiwara Chika vuole fare una sorpresa- Shirogane Miyuki vuole parlare - L'impresa impossibile di Kaguya Shinomiya
value.synopsis: In un futuro non troppo lontano, una Kaguya adulta ripercorre alcuni ricordi sfogliando un album fotografico.

value.title: L'ABC tra uomini e donne- Kaguya vuole parlare - Kaguya vuole fare dei saluti
value.synopsis: Un invito a cena si trasforma per i due geni della Shuchi'in in un'ennesima, ultima guerra d'amore.
